findings.summary: Requirement R1 (recursive Markdown discovery) is not explicitly traced to any M1 deliverable, creating a gap between the requirement and the milestone that claims to satisfy it.

evidence.note: R1 requires recursive discovery of .md files
evidence.quote: The system MUST accept a user-specified folder (or repository working directory) as input and recursively discover Markdown (.md) files

evidence.note: M1 deliverables include File Collector Plugin (DL4) but R1 is not explicitly listed in M1 exit criteria
evidence.quote: File Collector Plugin (C9) that recursively discovers .md files and populates the noteRegistry.

evidence.note: AT1 maps to R1 but references M1 and M2 in the sample check without clear M1 exit validation
evidence.quote: All .md files in all subfolders are included as notes; non-.md files are excluded.

findings.summary: Requirement R2 (static-only output) acceptance test AT2 is listed in the sample as validating M1 and M2, but M1 exit criteria do not include any validation of static-only output generation, only plugin infrastructure.

evidence.note: R2 mandates static-only output with no server-side runtime
evidence.quote: The system MUST generate a static website output consisting only of static files

evidence.note: M1 exit criteria focus on plugin API and orchestrator, not on static output validation
evidence.quote: Core Orchestrator executes all lifecycle hooks in the correct order with registered plugins.

evidence.note: AT2 requires inspecting output directory for static-only assets, but M1 does not produce a complete site
evidence.quote: Build completes successfully; output contains only static assets (HTML/CSS/JS/media)

findings.summary: Requirement R3 (Markdown rendering with formatting preservation) is tested by AT3 (human_eval), but M1 exit criteria only validate AST production, not HTML rendering or formatting preservation, creating a validation gap.

evidence.note: R3 requires faithful Markdown-to-HTML rendering preserving structure
evidence.quote: The system MUST parse and render each input Markdown file into a corresponding static HTML page while preserving Markdown formatting

evidence.note: M1 validates AST production but not HTML rendering or formatting preservation
evidence.quote: Markdown Parser Plugin produces correct AST and extracts frontmatter for representative Markdown files.

evidence.note: AT3 requires visual comparison of rendered HTML, which cannot be satisfied in M1
evidence.quote: Build the site and visually compare rendered HTML output to expected formatting.
